unit: USD per million tokens, API list price at standard speed: Anthropic's for the claude models, OpenAI's for the gpt models
note: Written by hand. Anthropic: cache writes are 1.25x input for the 5-minute TTL and 2x input for the 1-hour TTL. OpenAI (rows with their own as_of): a model's cache writes are its 30-minute rate under cache_write_5m and its 12-hour rate under cache_write_1h, and a call whose prompt is over long_context.above tokens is priced whole at the long_context rates. Codex reports tokens and no dollars, and what a subscription bills is not these prices. Editing this file changes every metrics.json on the next sync, including those of sessions traced in another jj workspace (from their stored logs).
